package com.x;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
/**
 * BDash: a facade. The integrator links control points into {@code status} (display)
 * and the servlet writes back to {@code setpoint} on operator input.
 */
@NiagaraType
@NiagaraProperty(
  name = "setpoint",
  type = "double",
  defaultValue = "0d",
  flags = Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.OPERATOR
)
@NiagaraProperty(
  name = "status",
  type = "double",
  defaultValue = "0d",
  flags = Flags.SUMMARY
)
public class BDash extends BComponent {
}
